phases.title: Exact-head policy, T0 registration and documentation correction
scope: Freeze the PR #16 merged rebase point and exact-head evidence policy.
Register the bounded T0 consumer inside check:lfea-core.
Correct the workspace-consumers and public-gateway documentation statements.
Add fail-closed release-readiness policy without promoting application qualification.

phases.title: Formal retirement of orphaned continuum Local FEA consumer suite
scope: Remove the stale LFEA-007 workflow, static scripts, browser suite and obsolete implementation document together.
Preserve the historical v10 schema as a legacy closed contract while proving the active v11 registry does not advertise LOCAL_FEA.
Preserve the independent active LAFEA and LFEA workbenches and prevent the retired suite from becoming Priority 2 evidence.

phases.title: Compile explicit B-2.5 and B-3.0 source authorities before T0
scope: Accept a closed source-authority request rather than precompiled B-2.5 and B-3.0 records.
Compile the mechanical model and physical load case through their existing production APIs.
Derive the B-3.0 model reference from the compiled B-2.5 record and reject caller injection.
Bind expected source, conditioned-topology, compiler-profile and load-case-profile hashes before delegating to T0.
Preserve explicit non-scope for raw project-file parsing, interfaces, nozzle assessment, code orchestration and presentation.

phases.title: Complete retained InputXML multi-case application orchestration
scope: Consume multiple retained InputXML analysis contexts under one exact source, content, topology, compilation, mechanical-model and stiffness authority.
Retain deterministic node source ancestry from incident raw InputXML span component UIDs and caller-approved B-2.5 element-binding component IDs without changing the stiffness-state projection.
Compile one governed interface set, recover every physical case and create deterministic interface envelopes through the existing Phase 3 APIs.
Assess each configured nozzle profile in every retained case and deterministically retain the governing assessment without deriving allowables.
Compile sustained, occasional and ordered displacement-range B31.3 checks from retained B-3.4 recoveries through the existing Phase 4 APIs.
Seal and independently revalidate the complete multi-case application parent and evidence chain without duplicating parser, compiler, solver, recovery or code mechanics.

phases.title: Governed InputXML length-unit normalization before B-1
scope: Preserve request v1 as a metre-only compatibility boundary and introduce request v2 with a required caller-supplied normalization profile.
Use an exact rational registry for m, mm, cm, in and ft rather than inferred units or decimal conversion approximations.
Normalize all classified InputXML length fields before B-1 conditioning and reject unclassified numeric geometry fields.
Retain source unit, target unit, rational scale, profile identity and geometry identities inside InputXML ingestion evidence.
Require equivalent metre and millimetre fixtures to produce the same conditioned topology, stiffness state and numerical results.

phases.title: Governed support, anchor and nozzle interfaces with reaction recovery
scope: Bind support and anchor interfaces to governed support-attachment, restraint-capability and B-2.5 constraint authorities.
Require explicit right-handed frames, reference points, reference-to-node lever vectors and six-DOF mappings.
Recover interface resultants only from B-3.3 constrained reactions, with declared sign convention, local transformation and reference-point transfer.
Produce deterministic component envelopes retaining governing load-case and recovery identities.
Bind explicit nozzle interface identity without performing nozzle allowable assessment, and keep gaps, friction, lift-off and contact blocked.

phases.title: Configured nozzle assessment and B31.3 application orchestration
scope: Assess governed nozzle-interface actions only against caller-supplied, hash-bound allowable profiles.
Resolve sustained and occasional B31.3 actions from one sealed B-3.4 recovery and displacement stress range from an explicit ordered recovery pair.
Delegate stress equations and allowable evaluation to the existing B-4.0 code engine without accepting caller-injected local actions.
Seal a current-only application result across analysis, interface recovery, nozzle assessment and B31.3 result identities.
Keep engineering PASS or FAIL separate from calculation qualification and preserve unconfigured nozzle profiles explicitly.

phases.title: Current-only read-only presentation and deterministic evidence exports
scope: Compile a presentation only when every analysis, interface recovery, nozzle assessment and B31.3 parent matches the sealed application result.
Require the current application identity again at render and export time so a previously valid presentation cannot remain usable after an application change.
Render support, anchor, nozzle and code result tables through a read-only textContent-only workspace view.
Permit current conditional results only as explicit audit JSON and block engineering issue CSVs unless the application is fully QUALIFIED and all nozzle profiles are configured.
Emit deterministic interface, nozzle and B31.3 CSV records containing units, sign convention and direct semantic and evidence identities.
